$comment: IMP-0181 byte-stability snapshot. Regenerate via packages/shared/scripts/regen-tool-index-snapshot.mjs after intentional changes to TOOL_SCHEMAS or buildDispatcherDescription. The contract test will fail if this file drifts from the live builder.
description:
Dispatches any humanchrome browser-automation tool by name. Args validated server-side; on INVALID_ARGS the response carries `details.expected` (schema fragment) and `details.hint` (did-you-mean) so you can self-correct in one round-trip.
Call as `{ name: "<tool>", args: { ... }, raw?: boolean }`. Set `raw: true` to bypass the dispatcher's output-size cap.
Catalog:
- browser_alias_tab: Bind a per-client alias to an owned tab so later calls can target it by name.
- browser_claim_tab: Claim an unowned tab into the calling client's owned set so implicit tab-resolution can target it.
- browser_close_my_tabs: Close every tab owned by the calling client; optional keep[] preserves specific tabIds.
- chrome_action_badge: Set or clear a small badge on the extension icon (text truncated to ~4 chars by Chrome).
- chrome_alarms: Schedule one-shot or repeating chrome.alarms callbacks; fires broadcast as alarm_fired runtime messages.
- chrome_aria_snapshot: Token-efficient Playwright-style ARIA tree snapshot returning indented `- role "name" [ref=ref_N]` lines; refs round-trip into selectorType:"ref".
- chrome_assert: Run one or more predicates against the page and return structured pass/fail; ok is AND of all predicates.
- chrome_await_element: Wait via MutationObserver for an element to be present or absent; returns immediately if goal state already true.
- chrome_basic_auth: Autoresponder for HTTP Basic/Digest 401 prompts via CDP Fetch.continueWithAuth — chrome_handle_dialog cannot.
- chrome_block_or_redirect: Block or redirect URLs via declarativeNetRequest session rules (cleared on Chrome restart).
- chrome_bookmark_add: Add a new bookmark; optional parentId targets a folder, createFolder:true auto-creates missing folder paths.
- chrome_bookmark_delete: Delete a bookmark by id (preferred) or by matching url/title.
- chrome_bookmark_search: Search Chrome bookmarks by title/URL substring; optional folderPath scopes to a subtree.
- chrome_bookmark_update: Rename, re-URL, or move a bookmark; identify by bookmarkId (preferred) or url+optional matchTitle.
- chrome_clear_browsing_data: Wipe browsing-data stores via chrome.browsingData.remove.
- chrome_click_element: Click an element by CSS/XPath/Playwright locator, ref, or viewport coordinates.
- chrome_clipboard: Read or write the system clipboard via the offscreen document (only context where navigator.clipboard works from a SW).
- chrome_close_tab: Close one or more tabs by tabIds[] or by matching url.
- chrome_close_tabs_matching: Bulk close tabs by filters; at least one of urlMatches/titleMatches/olderThanMs required (no-filter rejected).
- chrome_combobox_select: Trusted commit of a React/Ember combobox option via keyboard.
- chrome_computer: Mouse/keyboard/screenshot omnibus tool driving the browser like a computer.
- chrome_console: Capture console output: snapshot mode (one-time ~2s wait) or buffer mode (persistent per-tab, instant read/clear).
- chrome_console_clear: Reset the per-tab chrome_console buffer (and chrome_assert console_clean predicate) so subsequent reads are scoped to after the clear.
- chrome_context_menu: Register transient right-click menu items via chrome.contextMenus; clicks emit context_menu_clicked events over the bridge.
- chrome_debug_dump: Return recent extension debug-log entries correlated by requestId to the MCP call that produced them; filters compose AND.
- chrome_dev_reload: Trigger chrome.runtime.reload() from the SW so unattended E2E rebuild→reload→re-test runs need no operator click.
- chrome_download_cancel: Cancel an in-progress download by id via chrome.downloads.cancel.
- chrome_download_list: Enumerate downloads via chrome.downloads.search to find in-progress ids, check state, or list completed saved paths.
- chrome_drag_drop: Drag from one element to another by synthesizing the full HTML5 DnD + Pointer-Event chain (pointerdown→dragstart→N moves→drop→dragend).
- chrome_emulate: Per-tab CDP Emulation overrides (UA, locale, timezone, geolocation, device, color-scheme).
- chrome_fill_or_select: Fill or select an input/textarea/select/checkbox/radio by selector or ref.
- chrome_focus: Focus an element by selector or ref before keyboard input (chrome_paste, chrome_keyboard).
- chrome_get_attributes: Read DOM attributes, properties, and computed CSS by selector or ref.
- chrome_get_cookies: Read cookies via chrome.cookies.getAll.
- chrome_get_web_content: Fetch a page's raw HTML, plain text, or reader-mode Markdown.
- chrome_get_windows_and_tabs: List every currently open browser window and its tabs.
- chrome_gif_recorder: Record a tab as an animated GIF.
- chrome_handle_dialog: Handle JS alert/confirm/prompt dialogs via CDP.
- chrome_handle_download: Wait for the next browser download (optionally matching filenameContains) and return its details.
- chrome_har_export: Format chrome_network_capture buffers as HAR 1.2 JSON for DevTools/Charles/Playwright import.
- chrome_history: Search browsing history via chrome.history.search.
- chrome_history_delete: Delete browsing history entries (chrome.history.deleteUrl/deleteRange/deleteAll).
- chrome_hover: Programmatic mouse hover to trigger tooltips and dropdown menus (mouseover→mouseenter→pointerenter chain with actionability).
- chrome_identity: OAuth2 + profile lookup via chrome.identity for calling Google APIs without browser consent flows.
- chrome_idle: Query user idle state via chrome.idle.queryState (active|idle|locked) to back off intrusive ops or skip screenshots when locked.
- chrome_inject_script: Inject a one-off content script into a tab (ISOLATED or MAIN world) with a custom event bridge.
- chrome_intercept_response: Wait for the next network response matching urlPattern on a tab and return its parsed JSON body.
- chrome_javascript: Execute JS in a tab via CDP Runtime.evaluate (awaitPromise, returnByValue) with chrome.scripting ISOLATED fallback.
- chrome_keep_awake: Prevent system sleep during long runs via chrome.power.requestKeepAwake.
- chrome_keyboard: Simulate keyboard input — single keys, chords, text, or a high-level shortcut enum (copy/paste/undo/save/etc.) that maps to the platform-correct chord at dispatch.
- chrome_list_frames: List frames in a tab via chrome.webNavigation.getAllFrames as {frameId, parentFrameId, url, errorOccurred}; main doc is frameId:0.
- chrome_list_injected_scripts: List user scripts currently injected via chrome_inject_script across tabs as {tabId, world, scriptLength, injectedAt}.
- chrome_locator_handler: Auto-dismiss sticky overlays (cookie banners, GDPR modals) that intercept clicks.
- chrome_mock_response: Synthesize fake response bodies for matched URLs via CDP Fetch.fulfillRequest before the request leaves the browser.
- chrome_native_type: Bug-008 workaround: types into an input via REAL OS-level keystrokes (osascript on macOS).
- chrome_navigate: Navigate to a URL, refresh, or go back/forward in history.
- chrome_navigate_batch: Open many URLs at once and return their tabIds; tabs open backgrounded by default.
- chrome_network_capture: Capture network traffic on a tab.
- chrome_network_emulate: Emulate network conditions on a tab via CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions.
- chrome_network_request: Send a network request from the browser carrying its cookies and origin context.
- chrome_notifications: Push native OS notifications via chrome.notifications.
- chrome_owned_tabs: Return tabs owned by the calling MCP client as {tabId, windowId, url, title, active, isPinnedActive}.
- chrome_pace: Set a per-MCP-client pacing profile so mutating tools sleep a profile-derived gap before firing (human-like rhythm for anti-bot platforms).
- chrome_pace_get: Read-only counterpart of chrome_pace.
- chrome_paste: Focus an element by selector or ref and paste text — seeds the clipboard then dispatches BOTH a synthetic ClipboardEvent and execCommand(insertText) so rich editors and plain inputs both accept it.
- chrome_performance_analyze_insight: Lightweight summary of the last recorded performance trace.
- chrome_performance_start_trace: Start a performance trace recording on the selected page.
- chrome_performance_stop_trace: Stop the active performance trace recording on the selected page.
- chrome_print_to_pdf: Save a tab as PDF via CDP Page.printToPDF.
- chrome_proxy: Set/clear/inspect proxy config via chrome.proxy.settings.
- chrome_queue_inspect: Diagnostic snapshot of per-tab serialization queues with EWMA wait estimates.
- chrome_read_page: Return an accessibility-tree snapshot of viewport-visible elements; optionally filter to interactive-only or expand from a refId.
- chrome_remove_cookie: Delete a single cookie by URL + name via chrome.cookies.remove.
- chrome_remove_injected_script: Tear down a user script previously installed via chrome_inject_script by sending humanchrome:cleanup and dropping the tab from the registry.
- chrome_request_element_selection: Request the user to manually select elements on the page as a human-in-the-loop fallback.
- chrome_runtime_info: Return SW identity for E2E runners to verify bundle freshness.
- chrome_screenshot: Take a screenshot of the page or element.
- chrome_search_tabs_content: Semantic vector search across content of currently open tabs.
- chrome_select_text: Select text inside an element via setSelectionRange (inputs) or DOM Range (everything else).
- chrome_send_command_to_inject_script: Dispatch a user-defined event to a script previously installed via chrome_inject_script.
- chrome_sessions: Inspect and restore recently-closed tabs/windows via chrome.sessions.
- chrome_set_checked: Idempotent checkbox/radio/switch state set — matches Playwright locator.setChecked.
- chrome_set_cookie: Set a single cookie via chrome.cookies.set.
- chrome_set_extra_http_headers: Inject extra HTTP headers on every request a tab makes via CDP, persistent until cleared.
- chrome_storage: Read/write/clear a tab's localStorage or sessionStorage via a MAIN-world shim.
- chrome_switch_tab: Switch focus to a specific browser tab.
- chrome_tab_groups: Manage Chrome tab groups (create/update/query/get/add_tabs/remove_tabs/move) for partitioning agent tabs from user tabs.
- chrome_tab_lifecycle: Memory and audio controls: discard, mute, unmute, set_auto_discardable.
- chrome_type_into: Char-by-char keystroke typing with realistic per-key delay to bypass anti-bot cadence heuristics.
- chrome_typeahead_probe: Bug-008 diagnostic: types a sample char into a typeahead input then reports every event that fired (with isTrusted), every fetch the page made, and final aria-expanded/aria-controls/listbox state in one envelope.
- chrome_upload_file: Upload files to a form's file input via CDP.
- chrome_userscript: Unified userscript tool (create/list/get/enable/disable/update/remove/send_command/export).
- chrome_wait_for: Wait for one of: element, network idle, response, JS expression, load state, or URL pattern.
- chrome_wait_for_tab: Block until a tab reaches status:complete via chrome.tabs.onUpdated (no polling).
- chrome_web_vitals: Live Core Web Vitals collector via PerformanceObserver in MAIN world.
- chrome_window: Manage Chrome windows via chrome.windows (create/focus/update/close).
- record_replay_flow_delete: Delete a recorded flow by ID; always unpublishes first so the dynamic flow.<slug> MCP tool disappears.
- record_replay_flow_run: Run a recorded flow by ID with per-step outcomes.
- record_replay_list_published: List recorded flows published as dynamic MCP tools.
